schema_props.json lists, per FollowTheMoney schema, the ancestor schemas, property names and required properties,
extracted from the YAML schema files of followthemoney 4.11.3 (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2017-2024 Journalism
Development Network, Inc.; (c) 2025 OpenSanctions Datenbanken GmbH). The library itself is NOT a dependency: it needs
PyICU, which does not build here, so src/ihale/openexport.py writes the entities by hand and the test checks every
property against this list.
